nodes.name: 🔁 Loop (50 users)
nodes.notes:
'done' output (index 0) → leave UNCONNECTED.
'loop' output (index 1) → Add Discord Role.
Loop runs because Rate Limit Pause connects back to this node's INPUT.

nodes.name: 🎭 Add Discord Role
nodes.notes:
Processes all 50 items in the current batch sequentially.
continueOnFail means individual failures are captured as error items rather than crashing the batch.

nodes.name: 📦 Build Batch Update
nodes.notes:
Pairs each Discord result with the original loop item by index (order is preserved).
Outputs a single batchUpdate payload covering all rows in the batch.
Edit SPREADSHEET_ID, and the column letters if your sheet layout differs.

nodes.name: 📝 Batch Update Sheets
nodes.notes:
Calls the Google Sheets batchUpdate API — updates all rows in the batch in ONE request.
Uses the same Google Sheets OAuth2 credential as the other Sheets nodes.
continueOnFail: if Sheets is temporarily unavailable the batch rows stay blank and are retried on the next run.

nodes.name: ⏳ Pause Between Batches
nodes.notes:
3 seconds between batches of 50 = ~1000 users/minute.
Increase if you see Discord rate limit errors; the Sheets quota is no longer a concern.

parameters.content:
## Discord Mass Role Assignment

### Flow
```
[Trigger]
  → Read Config           (1 row → guild_id, role_id)
  → Get Pending Users     (blank status rows only)
  → Loop  'loop' output  (50 users per batch)
  → Add Discord Role      (processes all 50 sequentially)
  → Build Batch Update    (Code — 1 Sheets payload for all 50)
  → Batch Update Sheets   (HTTP → 1 API call for all 50 rows)
  → Pause Between Batches (3 sec)
  → back to Loop
```
**Loop 'done' output → leave UNCONNECTED.**

---

### Why batch updates?
Google Sheets allows ~300 write API calls per minute.
Updating 1 row per user = 300 calls/min limit hit immediately.
Updating 50 rows per API call = only 1 call per batch → quota is irrelevant.

---

### Setup checklist
- [ ] Replace `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID` in:
  - Read Config node
  - Get Pending Users node
  - Build Batch Update Code node (SPREADSHEET_ID constant)
  - Batch Update Sheets URL
- [ ] Set Google Sheets OAuth2 credential on Read Config, Get Pending Users, Batch Update Sheets
- [ ] Set Discord Bot credential on Add Discord Role
- [ ] Confirm Users sheet columns: B=status, C=timestamp, D=error
  (edit column constants in Build Batch Update if different)

---

### Google Sheets layout
**Config tab** — one data row:
| guild_id | role_id |
|----------|---------|
| 123...   | 987...  |

**Users tab:**
| user_id | status | timestamp | error |
|---------|--------|-----------|-------|
|         |        |           |       |

---

### Throughput
50 users per batch · 3 sec pause · ~1,000 users/min
10k users ≈ 10 min · 600k users ≈ 10 hrs across scheduled runs
